scope: inferred finite axisymmetric 3D HI density and circular mean velocity fitted through beam-projected moment maps

observation_metadata.velocity_convention_note: Moment-1 source unit retained; source cube has legacy VELO-HEL interpreted VOPT by WCSLIB. No frame transformation performed.
observation_metadata.coordinate_origin_role: FITS celestial WCS reference; not assumed galaxy centre
observation_metadata.coordinate_map: spherical sky-offset longitude/latitude in arcsec, east/north
observation_metadata.initial_geometry_role: positive-intensity joint-mask moments; optimizer seeds only, 180-degree PA ambiguity retained
observation_metadata.flux_scope: sum of finite source moment-0 values, including negatives and zeros; constant projected-plane pixel area/beam area; missing footprint not extrapolated
observation_metadata.flux_area_approximation: projected-plane pixel solid-angle approximation, not exact curved-sky per-pixel area
observation_metadata.mask_scope: source missingness preserved; joint positive selection is not an observed physical boundary
observation_metadata.column_density_note: coldens BUNIT/HISTORY conflict is not resolved by this intensity-only adapter

data_selection.sampling: source pixel centres; no averaging or missing-value imputation
data_selection.intensity_mask: all sampled finite nonzero source moment0 values; includes negative noise, excludes zero-filled source-mask exterior
data_selection.velocity_mask: sampled finite source moment1 with positive finite source moment0; fixed for every model
data_selection.crop_role: computational view containing every selected observation plus margin; PSF halo rendered outside view; full source footprint flux separately checked

model.radial_basis: piecewise-linear hats with zero last endpoint, normalized by analytic 2*pi*integral R hat(R) dR
model.radial_knot_rule: dense uniform inner knots through 99.5 percent of positive selected flux radius plus one beam; two outer knots through furthest selected sample plus beam; no observations excluded
model.outlying_emission_membership: unclassified observed components; retained in loss; outer model density is not an authenticated galactic halo
model.vertical_profile: exp(-abs(z)/h)/(2h), all real z; Gauss-Laguerre projection
model.velocity_model: basis-weighted circular streaming; fitted LOS mean; no equilibrium or time-transition law
model.beam: normalized elliptical Gaussian from source BMAJ/BMIN/BPA; render incoming six-sigma halo before zero-padded convolution and moment division
model.mass_constraint: fixed catalog estimate, conditional; uncertainty unsupplied; not exact empirical truth or independent constraint
model.optimizer: two-stage density-intensity and flux-weighted velocity least squares, followed by bounded geometry profile/coordinate search; no joint-global-minimum claim
model.angle_and_distance_map: spherical angular offsets mapped by small-angle Euclidean geometry; floating-point pi/trigonometry, not native octal coordinates

boundary_accounting.grid_deficit_interpretation: combines projection quadrature/pixel sampling and model emission outside grid; not a certified physical lost-mass measurement

metric_definitions.score: intensity NRMSE squared + intensity-weighted velocity RMSE squared / observed half 5th–95th velocity range squared
metric_definitions.intensity_wape_fraction: sum(abs(model-data))/sum(abs(data)) on fixed intensity mask; fraction, not percent or MAPE
metric_definitions.velocity_rmse_km_s: unweighted root mean square LOS velocity residual on fixed velocity mask

identifiability: retained finite geometry alternatives are fits, not confidence intervals or proof of unique depth; optimizer is local bounded search
unmodeled: line profile dispersion and multiple components
